cstmr_name like CONCAT('%', #{cstmrName}, '%')

AND replace(telephone,'-','') like CONCAT('%', #{telephone}, '%')

SELECT max(last_date) as last_date ,SP.shop_name as last_shop ,cstmr_id ,cstmr_login_id ,cstmr_login_pw ,cstmr_cd ,cstmr_name ,reg_shop_id ,reg_date ,t1.telephone ,cellphone ,sex_cd ,birth_day ,birth_day_ty_cd ,zip_cd ,t1.email ,t1.addr ,facebook ,twitter ,instagram ,get_sms_yn FROM (SELECT SO.datetime as last_date ,SO.shop_id ,C.cstmr_id ,cstmr_login_id ,cstmr_login_pw ,C.cstmr_cd ,cstmr_name ,reg_shop_id ,reg_date ,telephone ,cellphone ,sex_cd ,birth_day ,birth_day_ty_cd ,zip_cd ,email ,addr ,facebook ,twitter ,instagram ,get_sms_yn FROM cstmr C LEFT JOIN sale_off SO ON C.cstmr_id = SO.cstmr_id
C.cstmr_name = #{cstmrName}
AND (C.cstmr_cd = #{cstmrCd} or C.old_cstmr_cd = #{cstmrCd})
AND (C.fmly_cd = #{fmlyCd} or C.old_fmly_cd = #{fmlyCd})
AND C.addr like CONCAT('%', #{addr}, '%')
AND replace(C.cellphone,'-','') like CONCAT('%', #{cellphone}, '%')
AND C.birth_day like CONCAT('%', #{birthDay}, '%')
AND replace(C.telephone,'-','') like CONCAT('%', #{telephone}, '%')
AND (right(C.cellphone,4) = #{digit4} OR right(C.telephone,4) = #{digit4})
order by SO.datetime desc, cstmr_name asc )as t1 LEFT JOIN shop SP ON (SP.shop_id = t1.shop_id OR SP.shop_num = t1.shop_id) group by cstmr_id order by last_date desc, last_shop, cstmr_name

AND replace(telephone,'-','') like CONCAT('%', replace(#{telephone},"-",""), '%')
AND (right(cellphone,4) = #{digit4} OR right(telephone,4) = #{digit4})

cstmr_login_id = #{cstmrLoginId}

SELECT cstmr_id ,cstmr_login_id ,cstmr_login_pw ,cstmr_cd ,fmly_cd ,old_cstmr_cd ,old_fmly_cd ,cstmr_name ,reg_shop_id ,if(reg_shop_id < 70,(select shop_name from shop where shop_num = reg_shop_id),(select shop_name from shop where shop_id = reg_shop_id)) AS str_reg_shop ,reg_date ,telephone ,cellphone ,sex_cd ,birth_day ,birth_day_ty_cd ,zip_cd ,email ,addr ,facebook ,twitter ,instagram ,get_sms_yn ,get_email_yn ,get_coupon_yn ,get_dm_yn ,point FROM cstmr
cstmr_id = #{cstmrId}

SELECT cstmr_id ,cstmr_login_id ,cstmr_login_pw ,cstmr_cd ,fmly_cd ,old_cstmr_cd ,old_fmly_cd ,cstmr_name ,reg_shop_id ,if(reg_shop_id < 70,(select shop_name from shop where shop_num = reg_shop_id),(select shop_name from shop where shop_id = reg_shop_id)) AS str_reg_shop ,reg_date ,telephone ,cellphone ,sex_cd ,birth_day ,birth_day_ty_cd ,zip_cd ,email ,addr ,facebook ,twitter ,instagram ,get_sms_yn ,get_email_yn ,get_coupon_yn ,get_dm_yn ,point FROM cstmr
cstmr_cd = #{cstmrCd}

SELECT cstmr_id ,C.cstmr_cd ,C.cstmr_name , C.telephone , C.cellphone , C.addr , C.birth_day ,C.fmly_cd ,(select cstmr_name from cstmr where cstmr_cd = C.fmly_cd) as fmly_name ,(select telephone from cstmr where cstmr_cd = C.fmly_cd) as fmly_tel ,(select cellphone from cstmr where cstmr_cd = C.fmly_cd) as fmly_cell ,(select addr from cstmr where cstmr_cd = C.fmly_cd) as fmly_addr ,(select birth_day from cstmr where cstmr_cd = C.fmly_cd) as fmly_birth FROM cstmr C WHERE C.cstmr_name = #{cstmrName} AND (right(C.cellphone,4) = #{digit4} OR right(C.telephone,4) = #{digit4}) group by C.cstmr_cd order by C.cstmr_cd;
SELECT * FROM sale_off SO INNER JOIN visit_history VHC ON SO.cstmr_id=VHC.cstmr_id AND SO.datetime=VHC.datetime WHERE SO.cstmr_id=#{cstmrId} GROUP BY sale_id ORDER BY SO.datetime asc;
SELECT cstmr_name ,cstmr_cd ,addr ,telephone ,cellphone ,email ,sex_cd ,birth_day ,birth_day_ty_cd ,get_sms_yn ,get_email_yn ,get_coupon_yn FROM cstmr WHERE cstmr_id = #{cstmrId}
SELECT coupon_cd FROM coupon_birth WHERE cstmr_cd = #{cstmrCd} AND (shop_num = 0 OR shop_num is null)

SELECT Y.oldPrc + Y.newPrc totalPrc ,Y.visitCnt FROM( select count(sale_id) visitCnt ,(select IFNULL(sum(pay_card + pay_cash),0)*100 from sale_off where cstmr_id = #{cstmrId} AND is_old=1) oldPrc ,(select IFNULL(sum(pay_card + pay_cash),0) from sale_off where cstmr_id = #{cstmrId} AND is_old=0) newPrc from sale_off S where cstmr_id = ${cstmrId} )Y
SELECT cstmr_id, cstmr_name FROM cstmr WHERE fmly_cd = #{fmlyCd};

SELECT cstmr_name ,fmly_cd ,cstmr_id FROM cstmr WHERE fmly_cd = #{cstmrCd}
or fmly_cd = #{fmlyCd}
